name: Brodifacoum
summary: Brodifacoum is a highly lethal 4-hydroxycoumarin vitamin K antagonist anticoagulant poison. In recent years, it has become one of the world's most widely used pesticides. It is typically used as a rodenticide, but is also used to control larger pests such as possums.

pharmacology.text: Brodifacoum is a highly lethal 4-hydroxycoumarin vitamin K antagonist anticoagulant poison.

uses.text: In recent years, it has become one of the world's most widely used pesticides. It is typically used as a rodenticide, but is also used to control larger pests such as possums. Brodifacoum has an especially long half-life in the body, which ranges up to nine months, requiring prolonged treatment with antidotal vitamin K for both human and pet poisonings.

summaryZh: 可滅鼠（英語：Brodifacoum）是一種高致死性的4-羥基香豆素類維生素K拮抗劑和抗凝劑毒藥。 近年來，它已成為世界上使用最廣泛的農藥之一。 它通常用作滅鼠劑，但也用於控制較大的生物，如負鼠。
summaryZhHans: 溴鼠灵（英语：Brodifacoum）是一种高致死性的4-羟基香豆素类维生素K拮抗剂和抗凝剂毒药。 近年来，它已成为世界上使用最广泛的农药之一。 它通常用作灭鼠剂，但也用于控制较大的生物，如负鼠。

sideEffects.en: It causes bleeding: nosebleeds, bleeding gums, blood in the urine, heavy bruising and bleeding into the brain, which can be fatal. Because it persists so long, people poisoned by it have needed vitamin K treatment for months.
sideEffects.zh: 它會造成出血：流鼻血、牙齦出血、尿中帶血、大面積瘀青，以及可能致命的腦內出血。由於它在體內持續極久，中毒者曾需要接受數個月的維生素 K 治療。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会造成出血：流鼻血、牙龈出血、尿中带血、大面积瘀青，以及可能致命的脑内出血。由于它在体内持续极久，中毒者曾需要接受数个月的维生素 K 治疗。

fact.en: It is a rat poison, not a drug. It blocks vitamin K recycling so blood cannot clot, and it stays in the body for a remarkably long time. It has appeared as a contaminant in synthetic cannabinoid products, causing outbreaks of serious bleeding.
fact.zh: 溴鼠靈是滅鼠藥，不是藥物。它阻斷維生素 K 的回收，使血液無法凝固，並會在體內停留極長的時間。它曾作為合成大麻素產品的污染物出現，造成嚴重出血的群聚事件。
fact.zhHans: 溴鼠灵是灭鼠药，不是药物。它阻断维生素 K 的回收，使血液无法凝固，并会在体内停留极长的时间。它曾作为合成大麻素产品的污染物出现，造成严重出血的群聚事件。
